description: NACo County Explorer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Association of Counties. This visualization tool provides key county-level information on a wide variety of topics: demographics, the economy, education, healthcare, and public safety. Understanding county statistics (such as health risks, energy use, air pollution, and other factors) is important for planning climate resilience actions. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, People, Property, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
